latestVersion.changelog:
Video Maker Free Apps — Initial Release

- Quickly create and export 1080p MP4 videos from your photos, clips, and audio—no paid software needed.
- Supports popular file types: MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, and others up to 500MB.
- Handles uploading, editing, adding transitions, text overlays, and background music via an easy workflow.
- All video rendering and processing happens on cloud GPUs—ready in about 30–90 seconds.
- Session-based workflow lets you preview, edit, and export; credits system with free starter tokens for new users.
- Clear error messages, file type support, and tips for faster video creation.
